meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein **₹3,000 ke andar** ye options sabse practical hain—price sale aur size ke hisaab se badal sakti hai:

| Shoe | Approx. price | Kis ke liye |
|---|---:|---|
| **Nike Run Defy** | ₹2,700–3,000 | Best all-rounder; road running + walking |
| **Puma Skyrocket Lite** | ~₹2,999 | Regular 5K runs aur lightweight feel |
| **Skechers Go Run Consistent** | ~₹2,750 | Soft cushioning aur daily jogging |
| **ASICS Gel-Contend 4B+** | ~₹2,500 | Beginners, comfort aur support |
| **adidas Drogo M** | ~₹1,800–2,100 | Budget mein reliable brand |
| **Campus Trasko** | ~₹1,800 | Wide feet aur casual jogging |
| **Campus First / Campus Terminator** | ₹1,300–1,500 | Occasional jogging, walking, tight budget |
| **Reebok Stride Runner** | ₹1,000–2,000 | Gym + walking + light running |

**Meri recommendation:**
- **Best overall:** Nike Run Defy  
- **Serious daily 5K:** Puma Skyrocket Lite  
- **Comfort/support:** ASICS Gel-Contend 4B+  
- **₹2,000 ke andar:** adidas Drogo M  
- **₹1,500 ke andar:** Campus First  

Regular 5–10 km running ke liye Nike, Puma, Skechers ya ASICS lena behtar rahega; Campus/Sparx jaise options short jogs aur walking ke liye zyada suitable hain.[1][2][5][9]

Kharidte waqt toe-box mein lagbhag **thumb-width space**, breathable mesh aur achhi rubber grip check karein. Online price dekhte samay official brand store ya authorised seller se size-return policy zaroor verify karein.
